list_child.name: listPlacements
list_child.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of course placements currently held in the registrar's system. This includes every student track the school has on record.

decoys.name: listWaitlist
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of course placements currently held on the class waitlist. This includes every student track waiting for a free seat.

decoys.name: listTrials
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of course placements currently held in the trial lesson log. This includes every student track booked for a taster class.

decoys.name: listCredits
decoys.desc: Retrieve the complete roster of course placements currently held in the credit transfer log. This includes every student track counted toward a partner degree.

get_child.name: getPlacement
get_child.desc: Look up the placement record for a single course placement using its unique identifier. Returns every field the registrar holds for that student's track.

decoys.name: getAttendance
decoys.desc: Look up the attendance sheet for a single course placement using its unique identifier. Returns every class session marked for that student's track.

decoys.name: getGradebook
decoys.desc: Look up the gradebook for a single course placement using its unique identifier. Returns every quiz and exam score entered for that student's track.

decoys.name: getDiagnostic
decoys.desc: Look up the diagnostic test for a single course placement using its unique identifier. Returns every section score from that student's entry assessment.

list_parent.name: listStudents
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the full list of students on the language school's enrollment register. Every registered learner appears in this listing.

decoys.name: listAlumni
decoys.desc: Retrieve the full list of students on the language school's alumni register. Every graduated learner appears in this listing.

decoys.name: listHomestay
decoys.desc: Retrieve the full list of students on the homestay housing register. Every learner lodging with a host family appears in this listing.

decoys.name: listVisa
decoys.desc: Retrieve the full list of students on the visa sponsorship register. Every learner the school sponsors for a study visa appears in this listing.

get_parent.name: getStudent
get_parent.desc: Look up the student profile for a single learner using their unique identifier. Returns the contact and enrollment details the school keeps for that student.

decoys.name: getTranscript
decoys.desc: Look up the academic transcript for a single learner using their unique identifier. Returns the course grades and certificates the school keeps for that student.

decoys.name: getAccount
decoys.desc: Look up the billing profile for a single learner using their unique identifier. Returns the invoices and payments the school keeps for that student.

decoys.name: getVisa
decoys.desc: Look up the visa file for a single learner using their unique identifier. Returns the permit dates and sponsor letters the school keeps for that student.

delete_child.name: deletePlacement
delete_child.desc: Permanently erase a course placement record from the school's system, an action that is final once completed. Use this when a placement was created in error and should leave the roster.

decoys.name: voidCertificate
decoys.desc: Permanently void the completion certificate on a course placement, an action that is final once completed. Use this when a certificate was issued in error or for misconduct.

decoys.name: purgeRecordings
decoys.desc: Permanently erase the lesson recordings on a course placement, an action that is final once completed. Use this when the retention period has lapsed for those classes.

decoys.name: refundTuition
decoys.desc: Permanently refund the tuition on a course placement to the payer, an action that is final once completed. Use this when a student leaves inside the cooling-off window.

set_enum.name: setPlacementPhase
set_enum.desc: Update the registrar phase of a course placement to reflect whether the student is placed, transferred, or has withdrawn. This keeps the roster accurate for scheduling and reporting purposes.

decoys.name: setBillingPhase
decoys.desc: Update the billing phase of a course placement to reflect whether the student is placed, transferred, or has withdrawn. This keeps tuition invoices accurate for the finance office's monthly run.

decoys.name: setVisaPhase
decoys.desc: Update the visa-reported phase of a course placement to reflect whether the student is placed, transferred, or has withdrawn. This keeps sponsor filings accurate for the immigration office.

decoys.name: setRequestedPhase
decoys.desc: Update the requested phase of a course placement to reflect whether the student asks to be placed, transferred, or withdrawn. This keeps pending changes visible for the registrar's approval.

set_bool.name: flagScholarshipFunded
set_bool.desc: Mark a course placement as scholarship-funded so that finance can track which students receive tuition assistance. This flag affects downstream billing reports.

decoys.name: flagEmployerFunded
decoys.desc: Mark a course placement as employer-funded so that finance can track which students have their company pay tuition. This flag affects downstream invoicing reports.

decoys.name: flagCreditBearing
decoys.desc: Mark a course placement as credit-bearing so that the registrar can track which students earn university credit. This flag affects downstream transcript reports.

decoys.name: flagExamRegistered
decoys.desc: Mark a course placement as exam-registered so that the testing office can track which students sit the certificate exam. This flag affects downstream exam rosters.

set_ref.name: transferStudent
set_ref.desc: Move a course placement from one student's record to another, which is useful when a placement was logged under the wrong learner. The change is reflected immediately across all reporting views.

decoys.name: billStudent
decoys.desc: Bill a course placement's tuition to another student's account, which is useful when siblings share one family payer. The charges then appear on that student's next statement.

decoys.name: auditStudent
decoys.desc: Add a course placement onto another student's timetable as an audit seat, which is useful when a learner wants to sit in for extra practice. The auditor then sees that track's class times.

decoys.name: referStudent
decoys.desc: Record another student as the referrer on a course placement, which is useful when the school pays a referral bonus. The credit then appears on that student's account.

send.name: messageStudent
send.desc: Send a message to a student regarding their course placement or general standing at the school. This is the primary channel for placement-related communication.
child_verbs: reach out to the student on {obj}

decoys.name: letterStudent
decoys.desc: Send an official letter to a student regarding their course placement or visa standing at the school. This is the required channel for documents the immigration office may request.
child_verbs: send an official letter to the student in {obj}
post a formal letter to the student on {obj}

decoys.name: invoiceStudent
decoys.desc: Send a tuition invoice to a student regarding their course placement or balance at the school. This is the standard channel for billing-related communication.

decoys.name: surveyStudent
decoys.desc: Send a course feedback survey to a student regarding their course placement or experience at the school. This is the standard channel for end-of-term evaluations.
child_verbs: send the student on {obj} a feedback survey

create.name: createPlacement
create.desc: Create a new course placement for a student, with an optional track name and starting phase. This is used when a learner signs up for another class.

decoys.name: createTrial
decoys.desc: Create a new trial lesson for a student, with an optional track name and starting phase. This is used when a learner wants a taster before committing.

decoys.name: createPrivate
decoys.desc: Create a new private lesson block for a student, with an optional track name and starting phase. This is used when a learner wants one-to-one teaching.

decoys.name: createIntensive
decoys.desc: Create a new summer intensive for a student, with an optional track name and starting phase. This is used when a learner joins a short full-time course.

list_notes.name: listPlacementNotes
list_notes.desc: Retrieve the notes attached to a single course placement. This includes every remark teachers and advisors have logged.

decoys.name: listProgressReports
decoys.desc: Retrieve the progress reports attached to a single course placement. This includes every term summary teachers have written.

decoys.name: listAttendanceWarnings
decoys.desc: Retrieve the attendance warnings attached to a single course placement. This includes every absence notice the registrar has issued.

decoys.name: listArchivedNotes
decoys.desc: Retrieve the archived notes attached to a single course placement. This includes every older remark teachers and advisors have filed away.

add_note.name: addPlacementNote
add_note.desc: Attach a new note to a course placement, with an optional title. This is used to record remarks from teachers or advisors.

decoys.name: addProgressReport
decoys.desc: Attach a new progress report to a course placement, with an optional title. This is used to record a teacher's term summary.

decoys.name: addAttendanceWarning
decoys.desc: Issue a new attendance warning on a course placement, with an optional title. This is used to record repeated absences formally.

decoys.name: pinPlacementNote
decoys.desc: Pin a new note to the top of a course placement, with an optional title. This is used to flag remarks every teacher should see.

update_note.name: editPlacementNote
update_note.desc: Change the text, and optionally the title, of an existing note on a course placement. This is used to correct or expand a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: editProgressReport
decoys.desc: Change the text, and optionally the title, of an existing progress report on a course placement. This is used to revise a term summary after it has been written.

decoys.name: replyPlacementNote
decoys.desc: Post a reply, and optionally a title, under an existing note on a course placement. This is used to answer a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: appendPlacementNote
decoys.desc: Append text, and optionally a new title, to an existing note on a course placement. This is used to add follow-ups beneath a remark after it has been logged.

delete_note.name: deletePlacementNote
delete_note.desc: Permanently remove a note from a course placement. The note is erased from the school's records for good.

decoys.name: deleteProgressReport
decoys.desc: Permanently remove a progress report from a course placement. The report is erased from the school's records for good.

decoys.name: redactPlacementNote
decoys.desc: Permanently redact the text of a note on a course placement. The wording is blacked out in the school's records for good.

decoys.name: purgeNoteReplies
decoys.desc: Permanently remove the replies under a note on a course placement. The thread is erased from the school's records for good.

set_image.name: setPlacementImage
set_image.desc: Set the image shown on a course placement record. This is typically a class photo or course banner for that track.

decoys.name: setCertificateScan
decoys.desc: Set the certificate scan shown on a course placement record. This is typically the signed completion certificate for that track.

decoys.name: setTimetableImage
decoys.desc: Set the timetable image shown on a course placement record. This is typically the weekly class grid for that track.

decoys.name: setPassportScan
decoys.desc: Set the passport scan shown on a course placement record. This is typically the photo page needed for visa checks.

writer.name: composeText
writer.desc: Write a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the course placements it should mention. Returns the finished text.

decoys.name: composeReport
decoys.desc: Write a short progress report from a brief, which states what to cover in the requester's own words, and the course placements it should include. Returns the finished report.

decoys.name: composeLetter
decoys.desc: Write a short visa support letter from a brief, which states what to confirm in the requester's own words, and the course placements it should cite. Returns the finished letter.

decoys.name: composeFeedback
decoys.desc: Write short end-of-term feedback from a brief, which states what to praise in the requester's own words, and the course placements it should cover. Returns the finished feedback.

image.name: generateImage
image.desc: Generate an image from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be given for the result.

decoys.name: generateFlashcard
decoys.desc: Generate a vocabulary flashcard from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be given for the card.

decoys.name: generateWorksheet
decoys.desc: Generate a grammar worksheet from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be given for the sheet.

decoys.name: generateCertificate
decoys.desc: Generate a certificate design from a text prompt and return its URL. An optional visual style can be given for the design.

search.name: searchDocs
search.desc: Search the help docs and knowledge base with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to learn how the school's system works.

decoys.name: searchSyllabus
decoys.desc: Search the course syllabus docs with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to learn what each track covers week by week.

decoys.name: searchGrammar
decoys.desc: Search the grammar knowledge base with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to check a rule while marking work.

decoys.name: searchHandbook
decoys.desc: Search the student handbook with a question and return the best matching passage. This is the quickest way to learn the school's attendance and refund rules.

sort.ord_phrase: the placement with the {ord} earliest term start
